d: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar on November 20, 2026, announced a historic administrative and policing overhaul for Bengaluru, dividing the city into five Police Commissionerates and appointing five Police Commissioners alongside hundreds of newly created posts. Speaking to the media alongside Home Minister G. Parameshwara and Bengaluru ministers, Shivakumar noted that the old single-commissioner system was designed when the city's population was 10–20 lakh, whereas Greater Bengaluru (GBA) now serves 1.5 crore people.
